engineCorrectness.alphaBetaPruning: Not implemented as classical recursive alpha-beta tree; instead implements a 2-ply flat minimax lookahead with 14-move tactical beam search and 1-ply capture quiescence.
engineCorrectness.quiescenceSearch: Evaluates up to 5 immediate recaptures following opponent captures.

pieceSquareTables.orientation_finding: Identified PST orientation inversion: PAWN_PST indices 8..15 (Rank 2) hold values [+50, ...], which correspond to Rank 7 in standard top-down chess programming literature. Pawns advancing towards Rank 7 received +10 / -20 instead of the +50 promotion approach bonus. Corrected in evaluation.

engineCorrectness.kingSafety: King-distance penalty and destination square defense checks.
engineCorrectness.legalMoveGeneration: Strictly enforced by python-chess board.legal_moves; 0 illegal moves generated across 500+ tested positions.

hybridScoringVerification.fixedZeroWeightBug: Fixed bug in backend/main.py where personalizationWeight=0.0 was overridden to 0.65 due to python truthiness check.
hybridScoringVerification.antiBlunderFilter: Tested on tactical puzzle suite; successfully prevented queen loss and back-rank mate at w=0.65.

eloTesting.testingMethod: 20-game automated match tournament with alternating colors against calibrated depth-2 tactical heuristic engine (1400 Elo baseline)
eloTesting.criticalEloFinding: The 2200 Elo figure is an aspirational marketing label derived from Viknesh's personal high-accuracy human games, NOT a scientifically verified engine playing rating. A 2-ply hybrid Minimax engine with XGBoost move ranking typically plays at 1450-1650 Elo in standard time controls. FIDE/USCF Elo remains UNVERIFIED.
